text: The Patriots' Week 3 trip to Jacksonville turned into a 35-6 rout that left everyone searching for answers, with Drake Maye leading the self-examination after the rookie quarterback was responsible for three turnovers—two interceptions and a fumble—in what he himself called an "unacceptable" performance from both himself and the offense at large. The Jaguars' Trevor Lawrence made the Patriots pay with three touchdown passes, while Jacksonville coach Liam Coen's team responded exactly as advertised after he spent the week emphasizing how much their response mattered. On the defensive side, Marcus Jones recorded his first interception of the season, and second-round linebacker Gabe Jacas continued to make impact plays despite the lopsided scoreline, while the Patriots dealt with inactives at tight end (Eli Raridon with a thigh injury) and safety (Craig Woodson with a shoulder issue) that further complicated an already brutal afternoon in Florida.
